# Feature Requirements Quality Checklist: Fullswing CMS Admin Content Management

**Purpose**: Review the completeness, clarity, consistency, and testability of requirements before implementation
**Created**: 2026-09-26
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines that criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means requirements quality was reviewed and found satisfactory. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are Login, the Entra callback, and all protected CMS pages clearly distinguished so the authentication boundary is unambiguous? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001–FR-003]
- [ ] CHK002 Is the external administrator allowlist's ownership, provisioning, and update responsibility defined well enough to operate the stated authorization rule? [Dependency, Spec §FR-002, Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK003 Is the first-release Entra tenant/account scope specified, including whether identities from more than one tenant may be allowlisted? [Gap, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK004 Are all required GitHub workflow settings identified, including credential provisioning and replacement as well as repository, workflow, ref, and optional inputs? [Completeness, Spec §FR-013, FR-014, FR-021]
- [ ] CHK005 Are OneDrive metadata pairing, required fields, route uniqueness, malformed records, and orphaned sidecars covered as explicit content requirements? [Coverage, Spec §FR-008, Edge Cases]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK006 Is the meaning of “valid Markdown” bounded by explicit syntax/validation rules, including the treatment of raw HTML and remote code-fence sources? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-006–FR-009]
- [ ] CHK007 Are date-range boundary behavior, title matching, and combined dashboard-filter semantics defined precisely enough for consistent acceptance criteria? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK008 Are accepted versus failed GitHub dispatch states tied to the GitHub response, and distinguished from eventual workflow or deployment completion? [Clarity, Spec §FR-020, SC-011]
- [ ] CHK009 Are configured workflow inputs bounded by the target workflow's declared inputs, including which values are secret and which may be shown to reviewers? [Clarity, Spec §FR-021]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK010 Do provider-neutral future-provider requirements remain consistent with the constitution's OneDrive content-authority principle and the explicit first-release OneDrive-only scope? [Consistency, Spec §FR-010, FR-018, Assumptions; Constitution §III]
- [ ] CHK011 Is a blog's expected version defined consistently across its Markdown and metadata members, including after provider changes and concurrent edits? [Consistency, Spec §FR-011–FR-013; Plan §Data Model]
- [ ] CHK012 Are the dispatch target and inputs consistently saved in configuration and prohibited from being overridden by an individual trigger request? [Consistency, Spec §FR-013, FR-021, SC-012]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK013 Can every functional requirement be traced to an acceptance scenario or measurable success criterion, particularly delegated OneDrive access and workflow dispatch? [Traceability, Spec §FR-001–FR-021, SC-001–SC-012]
- [ ] CHK014 Are the thresholds and observable outcomes in success criteria measurable without relying on implementation-specific details? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001–SC-012]
- [ ] CHK015 Is “the provider does not require workflow rewrites” objectively bounded by the common storage contract and the workflows that must remain provider-independent? [Clarity, Spec §FR-018, SC-009]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK016 Are primary administrator journeys independently scoped and testable, including sign-in, content discovery, authoring, storage configuration, and workflow dispatch? [Coverage, Spec §User Stories 1–6]
- [ ] CHK017 Are alternate paths for changing provider and for an administrator lacking access to the configured OneDrive folder explicit and consistent? [Coverage, Spec §User Story 4, FR-019]
- [ ] CHK018 Are unauthorized users, expired sessions, invalid configuration, GitHub rejection, and provider outages covered as distinct exception scenarios? [Coverage, Spec §User Story 1, User Story 5, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK019 Are recovery expectations for partial sidecar writes, stale edits, rejected dispatches, and corrected integration settings defined, rather than only identifying the failure? [Recovery, Gap, Spec §FR-011–FR-013, FR-020]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK020 Are administrator behavior and error guidance specified when saving one member of a Markdown/metadata pair succeeds and the other fails? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-011, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK021 Are retry, duplicate-trigger, and throttling behaviors defined so repeated workflow requests cannot be mistaken for one successful run? [Gap, Spec §FR-020, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK022 Is the behavior defined when a provider change occurs while an editor is open and that stale form is later submitted? [Gap, Spec §FR-012–FR-013, Assumptions]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK023 Are dashboard latency and supported collection-size expectations specified for OneDrive enumeration, filtering, and pagination? [Gap, Plan §Technical Context]
- [ ] CHK024 Are availability, timeout, retry, and recovery expectations stated for Entra, OneDrive, and GitHub dependencies? [Gap, Spec §FR-017, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK025 Are audit and retention expectations defined for administrator sign-ins, content changes, provider switches, and GitHub dispatches without recording secret values? [Gap, Spec §FR-014, FR-020]
- [ ] CHK026 Are accessibility requirements sufficiently specific for login, filters, editor status, preview tabs, configuration errors, and dispatch feedback? [Coverage, Spec §FR-007, FR-016]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK027 Are durable storage responsibilities, access controls, and failure behavior defined separately for non-secret settings and secret credentials, given that hosting is outside the feature scope? [Dependency, Plan §Technical Context]
- [ ] CHK028 Is the requirement that every allowlisted administrator has permission to the configured OneDrive folder visible in both operator setup expectations and user-facing failure requirements? [Assumption, Spec §FR-019, Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK029 Are prerequisites for a dispatchable GitHub workflow, including that it is enabled and accepts manual triggers, explicit in the feature requirements rather than only design notes? [Dependency, Spec §FR-020–FR-021; Plan §Research]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [ ] CHK030 Is the scope boundary between provider-dependent HTML source editing and unavailable HTML rendering, execution, and publication consistent in the stories, requirements, and assumptions? [Consistency, Spec §User Story 6, FR-015]
- [ ] CHK033 Are the local public-directory requirements explicit about writability, year-derived paths, sidecar pairing, and path-traversal prevention? [Completeness, Spec §FR-013, FR-022–FR-023]
- [ ] CHK034 Is the local development composition's in-memory configuration limitation distinguished from the persistence of content files? [Clarity, Spec Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK031 Does the specification distinguish configuration replacement of secrets from secret readback, rotation, and revocation responsibilities? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-014, User Story 5]
- [ ] CHK032 Are any unquantified terms such as “clear,” “explicit,” or “accessible” tied to observable acceptance expectations where they affect sign-off? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004, FR-007, FR-016–FR-017]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied.
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation.
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers.
- `checklists/requirements.md` is a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`.
- Add review findings inline and link to relevant sections or resources.
